94.DSCR:
Another form of the $$ユニコーンガンダム$$, which appears when the special OS 'NT-D' installed in the unit activates.
The frame throughout its body extends, and the armor slides open at the seams, exposing the psycoframe that glows red beneath. The horn on its head also spreads open to the left and right as the unit 'transforms' into a $$ガンダム$$.
In this form, the pilot's thoughts, read through the frame throughout the body, are directly reflected in the unit's movements. This system makes it possible to move the machine by thought alone. In doing so, it becomes possible to draw out the unit's performance to its limits, producing mobility that exceeds human perception.
On the other hand, the G-forces generated by its mobility and the strain on the brain from using the $$サイコミュ$$ place a heavy burden on the pilot, and the operational limit a pilot can endure is thought to be around five minutes.
'NT-D' stands for 'Newtype Destroyer', and the system activates automatically when it detects the sensory waves of a $$ニュータイプ$$ or an Enhanced Human aboard an enemy unit.
Once this system activates, the $$サイコミュ$$ system overrides the pilot's will, and their thinking becomes fixated solely on destroying the enemy unit.
Because of this, it is speculated that the unit may have been developed as a hunting machine intended for the extermination of Newtypes.
The unit also has a system called the 'Laplace Program' built into it by $$カーディアス・ビスト$$'s own hand, one that was not part of its original specifications. Under certain conditions, this system progressively reveals the path leading to $$ラプラスの箱$$, giving the unit the role of a key to unlocking it as well.
Soon after he began piloting it, $$バナージ$$ was at the mercy of the NT-D, but as he grew, he became able to trigger Destroy Mode without being swallowed by the system.

95.DSCR:
The true form of the $$ユニコーンガンダム$$, which appears when the special OS 'NT-D' installed in the unit activates.
As $$バナージ$$'s $$ニュータイプ$$ ability grew, the glowing color of the $$サイコ・フレーム$$ changed to the same green that the $$νガンダム$$ gave off when it pushed back $$アクシズ$$.
Drawing out the power of the $$サイコ・フレーム$$, it caused various supernatural phenomena, beginning with the Psycho-Field.

96.DSCR:
A decisive-battle specification of the $$ユニコーンガンダム$$, loaded with as much of the equipment remaining aboard the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ as possible.
The refit was carried out based on an idea from $$バナージ$$'s friend $$タクヤ・イレイ$$, with adjustments by $$アーロン・テルジェフ$$ of $$アナハイム・エレクトロニクス$$.
Its armament centers on medium- to long-range firearms, 17 guns in total, including two Hyper Bazookas, an anti-ship missile launcher, and six beam gatling guns.
Two more shields were added and a large booster was also fitted, aiming to improve performance not only in firepower but also in defense and mobility.

97.DSCR:
The state of the $$フルアーマー・ユニコーンガンダム$$ with the NT-D activated.
The numerous weapons fitted over its whole body do not hinder movement even in Destroy Mode, where the body extends, and demonstrate the full attack performance they were given.
Through the $$サイコミュ$$, all of the firearms can be fired remotely, allowing a variety of offense and defense, such as all-range attacks by deploying the shields, each fitted with two beam gatlings, like funnels, or gathering them together into a powerful shield.

98.DSCR:
The second unit of the RX-0 $$ユニコーンガンダム$$, which specializes in mobile suits equipped with anti-psycommu gear, built as the core of the '$$ＵＣ計画$$.'
Having undergone final adjustments beforehand that included operation tests under gravity, and having newly been given the 'Armed Armor,' a specially designed additional $$サイコ・フレーム$$ equipment, it is a far more complete machine than Unit 1 despite being the same model.
Since it does not carry the $$ラプラス$$ Program and is not fully identical in specification, it is better described as a sibling unit than a same-model unit.
To eliminate the Newtypes of the Spacenoids, it was designed on the premise of being boarded by an Enhanced Human, an artificial $$ニュータイプ$$ so to speak.
$$マリーダ$$, re-adjusted into $$プルトゥエルブ$$, boarded it and attacked $$バナージ$$ and $$リディ$$ immediately after they defeated the $$シャンブロ$$.

99.DSCR:
The $$バンシィ$$ in Destroy Mode, having activated the NT-D ($$ニュータイプ$$ Destroyer) system, which dramatically enhances unit performance.
The $$サイコ・フレーム$$ exposed through the gaps in its black armor glows gold, and it becomes a hunting machine to fulfill the original purpose of the '$$ＵＣ計画$$.'
The glowing color of the $$サイコ・フレーム$$ is gold, unlike the red of the $$ユニコーンガンダム$$, but there is no difference in function, and the reason for the difference in glowing color has not been revealed.

100.DSCR:
A revised-specification version of the $$ユニコーンガンダム$$ Unit 2 $$バンシィ$$, with its equipment reworked.
It adopts an orthodox enhancement approach of improving the unit's base performance while increasing its ability to respond to situations.
To strengthen firepower and mobility, Armed Armors are mounted on the backpack and shield, and like Unit 1 it is also equipped with a Beam Magnum (the type fitted with a Revolving Launcher).
Piloted by $$リディ$$, who had come to serve under $$アルベルト$$, it displayed overwhelming power, such as toying with the mobile suit squad of the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$.

101.DSCR:
The $$バンシィ・ノルン$$ in Destroy Mode, having activated the NT-D ($$ニュータイプ$$ Destroyer) system, which dramatically enhances unit performance.
The $$サイコ・フレーム$$ exposed through the gaps in its black armor glows gold, and it becomes a hunting machine to fulfill the original purpose of the '$$ＵＣ計画$$.'
The deployment mechanisms of the unit's parts, driven by the NT-D system, work equally on the additional $$サイコ・フレーム$$ weapon systems it was given. In particular, the Armed Armor XC on its back changes into a shape reminiscent of a lion's mane.

104.DSCR:
The $$リゼル$$'s cruising configuration.
By converging the thrusters throughout the unit's body toward the rear, it achieves high mobility. Its weapons are mounted facing forward, so they remain usable even in this configuration.
The backpack on its rear has grips for mobile suits to hold onto, and by making use of its surplus thrust, it can also be operated as a sub flight system.
This coloring is that of the units deployed to the $$ゼネラル・レビル$$. Treatments were applied to return the unit to the $$リゼル$$'s original performance, such as removing the upper limit of the thrust limiter that had been set for the general-purpose units meant for everyone, and reinforcing the frame to match.

107.DSCR:
A mobile suit used by the Earth Federation Forces special unit 'ECOAS.'
For a mobile suit of this era of the $$宇宙世紀$$, it is quite small, and features a mechanism allowing it to transform into a tank configuration.
It was developed as a mobile suit for responding to sporadic terrorist acts by $$ネオ・ジオン$$ remnants and others, with an emphasis on rapid transport of troops in urban warfare and on anti-personnel suppression.
It is also equipped with various sensors and communication equipment so that it can be operated on-site as an operational command post.
It was developed by the Strategic Naval Research Institute (S.N.R.I.), and the operational data gathered from it also influenced the later development of small mobile suits.

A mobile suit used by the Earth Federation Forces special unit 'ECOAS.'

There is also optional equipment such as the Mega Machine Cannon and the Long Cannon.

108.DSCR:
A special-specification $$ジェガン$$ prepared for $$エコーズ$$ special missions in which direct combat with mobile suits is anticipated.
Additional sensors and extra armor on the chest raise its survivability.
It is painted like the $$ロト$$ and is mainly piloted by $$コンロイ$$.
It is equipped with a hand gun and dagger knives, and there was also a scene in which it fired the Mega Bazooka Launcher installed on the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$.

109.DSCR:
A new high-end mobile suit of the $$ジェガン$$ line, developed by Anaheim Electronics as an escort unit for the $$ユニコーンガンダム$$ under the '$$ＵＣ計画$$' advanced by the Earth Federation Forces.
As an escort for the $$ユニコーンガンダム$$, whose operating time in Destroy Mode is limited, its main mission is to suppress the enemy's conventional forces and create a situation in which the $$ユニコーンガンダム$$ and the enemy $$ニュータイプ$$ weapon confront each other directly.
It is currently deployed to the $$ラー・カイラム$$ as part of evaluation testing and is operated by $$トライスター$$, a combat squad of $$ロンド・ベル$$, but it was never operated for its original purpose of clearing the way for the $$ユニコーンガンダム$$.

112.DSCR:
A giant mobile armor for base assault, with the $$シナンジュ$$ as its core unit.
Equipped with numerous new weapons built on $$サイコ・フレーム$$ technology, it was deployed in the final battle over $$ラプラスの箱$$.
The $$ファンネル$$ bits in its fingers, fired from a total of six arms (four of which are stored on its back), can not only fire mega particle cannons but also take over the control systems of enemy units and other machines by being driven into them.
It can also deploy crystalline structures called '$$サイコシャード$$' like a halo, causing supernatural phenomena close to a Psycho-Field, and without even touching the $$ユニコーンガンダム$$, it made that unit's weapons self-destruct and robbed it of its combat ability.
The upper body of the core unit $$シナンジュ$$ can also be operated, and there were scenes of melee combat using the beam saber that the $$シナンジュ$$ had been equipped with.
112.DSC2:
A giant mobile armor for base assault, with the $$シナンジュ$$ as its core unit.

In the end, it came into contact with the Psycho-Field of the $$ユニコーンガンダム$$ and collapsed together with its pilot, $$フロンタル$$.

113.DSCR:
A Newtype-exclusive mobile suit owned by the $$袖付き$$.
It was designed near the end of the First Neo Zeon War with the aim of miniaturizing the 40m-class mobile suit Quin Mantha.
It adopts a $$サイコミュ$$ system made compact through the introduction of a $$サイコ・フレーム$$. By consolidating the $$ファンネル$$ container that had been the cause of the Quin Mantha's large size, along with internal weapons, the main thrusters, propellant tanks, and other various functions into its four binders, it succeeded in downsizing while maintaining performance equal to the Quin Mantha.
Its performance is high, and combined with the skill of its pilot $$マリーダ$$, when it fought at $$インダストリアル７$$ it single-handedly shot down much of the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$'s mobile suit force.
However, the $$袖付き$$ lack the resources to mass-produce this unit, and cannot even fully repair its damaged sections, leaving it effectively a one-off machine.
It was shot down in battle against the $$ユニコーンガンダム$$'s Destroy Mode, and recovered by the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$.

117.DSCR:
A prototype mobile suit developed on the basis of the $$ギラ・ズール$$, sublimating the concept of the $$ハンマ・ハンマ$$ once operated by the $$ネオ・ジオン$$ of $$アクシズ$$.
A unit that realizes at a high level the one-versus-many combat concept with which the $$袖付き$$, short of military strength, make up for their difference in force.
Designs modeled on the 'rose' from which its name derives can be seen in various parts, such as around the head and on the back binders.
Both arms, which contain triple mega particle cannons, are incoms, a quasi-psycommu weapon, and can be separated from the main body and remotely controlled by wire.
In addition, a rose-shaped anti-$$ユニコーンガンダム$$ device called the $$サイコジャマー$$ is loaded in the container on its back, and it has the function of nullifying the $$サイコミュ$$ weapons of enemy units trapped in an octahedral Psycho-Field.

120.DSCR:
A rear-support mobile suit developed during the First Neo Zeon War.
It carries many missiles on its small frame, and by fitting a large variable booster pod that can also be used in space as a suicide weapon against ships, it further accentuates the unit's defining trait of heavy firepower.
The $$袖付き$$ version is painted green and, to compensate for its comparatively weak melee performance against mobile suits, is equipped with hand-held weapons borrowed from other mobile suits, displaying combat power beyond the realm of support.

127.DSCR:
A faster-than-light all-purpose large transforming and combining machine weapon, developed by Kouichirou Ohta by gathering the pinnacle of fourth-generation FTL large spacecraft technology.
It is completed when $$バスターマシン$$ No. 1 and No. 2 combine.
Developed to overturn the balance of power against the $$宇宙怪獣$$, this unit possesses a bulk that defies the common sense of other machine weapons, along with the tremendous power produced by its two degeneration reactors.
Making use of that power, it has numerous weapons of extraordinary force built into it, including the minus-100-million-degree freeze ray 'Buster Beam' and the 'Double Buster Corrider,' which fires a current of 1 billion gigavolts.
When it was first operated in complete form at the Absolute Defense Line of Planet Raoh, it fought alone against countless $$宇宙怪獣$$ and overwhelmed them, living up fully to its design concept.
However, drawing out its performance to the fullest requires excellent piloting skill, and so its pilot is required to have a corresponding amount of 'effort' and 'guts.'
In the final battle, in order to detonate $$バスターマシン$$ No. 3, it self-destructed one of its degeneration reactors, leading the Carnedes Plan to success, but the unit itself was caught up in the resulting black hole and sent far away through time.
127.DSC2:
A faster-than-light all-purpose large transforming and combining machine weapon, developed by Kouichirou Ohta by gathering the pinnacle of fourth-generation FTL large spacecraft technology.
It is completed when $$バスターマシン$$ No. 1 and No. 2 combine.
Developed to overturn the balance of power against the $$宇宙怪獣$$, this unit possesses a bulk that defies the common sense of other machine weapons, along with the tremendous power produced by its two degeneration reactors.
Making use of that power, it has numerous weapons of extraordinary force built into it, including the minus-100-million-degree freeze ray 'Buster Beam' and the 'Double Buster Corrider,' which fires a current of 1 billion gigavolts.

Even with its body almost entirely damaged, it safely delivered $$ノリコ$$ and $$カズミ$$ to the Earth 12,000 years in the future, and thus finished its role.

131.DSCR:
A Space Monster that combines the strengths of various cruiser-class units.
It has superior power in every respect, but its numbers are few.
It was the first powerful enemy that $$ガンバスター$$ encountered; they fought a sub-light-speed battle, but its movement was stopped when $$ガンバスター$$ desperately caught it head-on, and it was smashed by the Buster Corrider.

132.DSCR:
The oldest $$バスターマシン$$ of the $$フラタニティ$$, piloted by $$ラルク$$.
A veteran warrior who has kept fighting for thousands of years, it bears many scars across its armor, beginning with the Space Monster's horn stuck in its right eye.
It can also fight solo without a pilot aboard, but cannot demonstrate its full power unless $$ラルク$$ pilots it.
Besides melee combat that makes use of its powerful strength and heavy armor, it is also well equipped with medium-range weapons, such as the Buster Beam fired from its joined fists, the Burning Wall multiple-launch homing missiles built into the armor coat, an additional piece of equipment, and the Evil Geyser released from its Hannya-like back, making it an all-around machine.
It can also transform into a rocket-shaped cruising configuration by donning the armor coat.
132.DSC2:
The oldest $$バスターマシン$$ of the $$フラタニティ$$, piloted by $$ラルク$$.
A veteran warrior who has kept fighting for thousands of years, it bears many scars across its armor, beginning with the Space Monster's horn stuck in its right eye.
It can also fight solo without a pilot aboard, but cannot demonstrate its full power unless $$ラルク$$ pilots it.
Besides melee combat that makes use of its powerful strength and heavy armor, it is also well equipped with medium-range weapons, such as the Buster Beam fired from its joined fists, the Burning Wall multiple-launch homing missiles built into the armor coat, an additional piece of equipment, and the Evil Geyser released from its Hannya-like back, making it an all-around machine.
It can also transform into a rocket-shaped cruising configuration by donning the armor coat.
By pulling out the Space Monster's horn stuck in its right eye, the path to the true cockpit hidden inside its artificial intelligence opens, and by taking in the degeneration reactor of the $$バスター軍団$$, it awakens as $$バスターマシン１９号$$.

133.DSCR:
The true form of $$ディスヌフ$$, which took in the degeneration reactor of the $$バスター軍団$$ as its 'heart.'
Instead of the control heart operated through $$トップレス$$ ability, it took in a degeneration reactor from the $$バスター軍団$$, which turned its body red, and its combat power rose to rival that of the legendary $$ガンバスター$$.
All the weapons usable as $$ディスヌフ$$ can be used, except for the transfer by quantization that relied on $$ラルク$$'s $$トップレス$$ ability. It is piloted from the 'original cockpit' hidden inside its artificial intelligence, by tracing the pilot's movements in the same way as $$ガンバスター$$.
At the same time as its body color changed, the chin guard at its mouth came off, and it moves its mouth in sync with $$ラルク$$'s speech.
133.DSC2:
The true form of $$ディスヌフ$$, which took in the degeneration reactor of the $$バスター軍団$$ as its 'heart.'
Instead of the control heart operated through $$トップレス$$ ability, it took in a degeneration reactor from the $$バスター軍団$$, which turned its body red, and its combat power rose to rival that of the legendary $$ガンバスター$$.
All the weapons usable as $$ディスヌフ$$ can be used, except for the transfer by quantization that relied on $$ラルク$$'s $$トップレス$$ ability. It is piloted from the 'original cockpit' hidden inside its artificial intelligence, by tracing the pilot's movements in the same way as $$ガンバスター$$.
At the same time as its body color changed, the chin guard at its mouth came off, and it moves its mouth in sync with $$ラルク$$'s speech.
In the final battle, it unleashed the Inazuma Double Kick together with $$バスターマシン７号$$ and destroyed the $$エグゼリオ変動重力源$$. After that, having finished its task of carrying $$ラルク$$ to the base, it burned out like pure white ash, its role complete.

134.DSCR:
A 20s-series $$バスターマシン$$ piloted by $$ニコラ$$.
Its distinguishing feature is heavily armed arms like a bird's wings, added to a slender body to suit $$ニコラ$$'s characteristics.
The Buster Megatech PK, which amplifies $$ニコラ$$'s $$トップレス$$ ability through the amplifiers in the heavily armed arms and puts surrounding weapons and cyberbrains under his control, is powerful, and its reality-rewriting ability even allows special attacks such as transforming $$宇宙軍$$ battleships into something like organic life forms and making them bite $$宇宙怪獣$$.
It is also capable of melee attacks with the Buster Swords, a pair of large and small swords, and carries the Buster Haken, semi-automatic homing missiles, on its shoulders.

135.DSCR:
The latest Buster Machine, piloted by $$チコ$$, and the first 90s-series machine to be built in several decades.
Because the $$ソワサンシス$$ that $$チコ$$ rode was lost just before the $$木星急行$$ interception operation was carried out, the schedule was hastily moved up and it was rolled out.
It is equipped with the Buster Racket, a weapon modeled on a tennis racket, and the finishing move fired from this racket, the Buster Smash, is a freeze ray of minus 1 trillion 20 million degrees.
It was in a state of not awakening when first rolled out, but it awakened and chose $$チコ$$ as its pilot. On its first sortie, it achieved the result of defeating the $$木星急行$$ at Jupiter.
135.DSC2:
The latest Buster Machine, piloted by $$チコ$$, and the first 90s-series machine to be built in several decades.
Because the $$ソワサンシス$$ that $$チコ$$ rode was lost just before the $$木星急行$$ interception operation was carried out, the schedule was hastily moved up and it was rolled out.
It is equipped with the Buster Racket, a weapon modeled on a tennis racket, and the finishing move fired from this racket, the Buster Smash, is a freeze ray of minus 1 trillion 20 million degrees.
It was in a state of not awakening when first rolled out, but it awakened and chose $$チコ$$ as its pilot. On its first sortie, it achieved the result of defeating the $$木星急行$$ at Jupiter.
The design motif is a 'tennis club member,' as can be seen from its weapons and so on.

136.DSCR:
A mass-production machine weapon widely operated by the $$宇宙軍$$.
Designed so that anyone can pilot it easily, it has high versatility, handling both ground and space missions with a few additional pieces of equipment.
Its fixed armament is a 90mm machine cannon mounted in a hole in the head, and depending on the mission it can carry various weapons and options, such as a grenade launcher, a reconnaissance antenna, space mines, and a Sasumata Corrider.
Though it lacks the ability to fight $$宇宙怪獣$$, it is used for various purposes not only by the $$宇宙軍$$ but also by the $$フラタニティ$$, such as reconnaissance and resupply missions for Buster Machines using support containers for option mechs.
It is painted pink-orange as $$ノノ$$'s exclusive unit, while the standard units are colored light gray.

137.DSCR:
The ultimate $$バスターマシン$$ created by human civilization, into which $$ノノ$$ transformed after regaining her memories.
She lived in the form of $$ノノ$$, but transforms into $$バスターマシン７号$$ following the incident on $$タイタン$$.
She is the entity that rules the $$バスター軍団$$, which had been called $$宇宙怪獣$$, and the $$宇宙軍$$ calls her the 'Goddess of the Solar System' and the 'Queen of the $$宇宙怪獣$$.'
Even after regaining her memories and becoming a $$バスターマシン$$, the innocent and cheerful personality that $$ノノ$$ had is unchanged, and she continues to adore $$ラルク$$.
137.DSC2:
The ultimate $$バスターマシン$$ created by human civilization, into which $$ノノ$$ transformed after regaining her memories.
She lived in the form of $$ノノ$$, but transforms into $$バスターマシン７号$$ following the incident on $$タイタン$$.
She is the entity that rules the $$バスター軍団$$, which had been called $$宇宙怪獣$$, and the $$宇宙軍$$ calls her the 'Goddess of the Solar System' and the 'Queen of the $$宇宙怪獣$$.'
Even after regaining her memories and becoming a $$バスターマシン$$, the innocent and cheerful personality that $$ノノ$$ had is unchanged, and she continues to adore $$ラルク$$.
In addition, by being stored in the head of the aggregate of Buster Machines, she can also become '$$ダイバスター$$.'
To save humanity from the greatest crisis in the universe, the collapse of the black hole that occurred in the final battle, she departed to the other side of the singularity.

138.DSCR:
A super-giant humanoid decisive-battle weapon for the absolute defense of the Solar System, an aggregate structure of several hundred million individuals of the $$バスター軍団$$ that make up the Red Milky Way.
With $$バスターマシン７号$$ housed in its head as the core, its enormous body, whose total length reaches 10,000 kilometers, is an aggregate of the $$バスター軍団$$ gathered like cells.
Since each individual of the $$バスター軍団$$ carries a degeneration reactor, it has countless degeneration reactors, and even when damaged, it repairs itself as the $$バスター軍団$$ is reconstituted.
The Buster Beam, Buster Corrider, and Ultra Inazuma Kick delivered from that huge body boast overwhelming power on a different order of magnitude from other weapons.
138.DSC2:
A super-giant humanoid decisive-battle weapon for the absolute defense of the Solar System, an aggregate structure of several hundred million individuals of the $$バスター軍団$$ that make up the Red Milky Way.
With $$バスターマシン７号$$ housed in its head as the core, its enormous body, whose total length reaches 10,000 kilometers, is an aggregate of the $$バスター軍団$$ gathered like cells.
Since each individual of the $$バスター軍団$$ carries a degeneration reactor, it has countless degeneration reactors, and even when damaged, it repairs itself as the $$バスター軍団$$ is reconstituted.
The Buster Beam, Buster Corrider, and Ultra Inazuma Kick delivered from that huge body boast overwhelming power on a different order of magnitude from other weapons.
Although it was originally built on the assumption of using $$ブラックホール・エグゼリオ$$ as its energy source, that black hole was taken by the $$エグゼリオ変動重力源$$, so it had to sortie in an unfinished state.
Its exterior design imitates the appearance of $$ノリコ$$, the hero who saved the Earth 12,000 years ago, clad in a combat suit.

139.DSCR:
A Space Monster that appeared in Episode 1, 'Please Let Me Call You Onee-sama!'
It has four long legs and a thick, bellows-like abdomen, and is characterized by abilities other than combat, such as tentacles with eyes for gathering information and a booster ability for escaping planetary gravity.
It was defeated by $$ディスヌフ$$'s Buster Beam.
139.DSC2:
A unit of the $$バスター軍団$$ that appeared in Episode 1, 'Please Let Me Call You Onee-sama!'
It has four long legs and a thick, bellows-like abdomen, and is characterized by abilities other than combat, such as tentacles with camera eyes for gathering information and a booster ability for escaping planetary gravity.
It was defeated by $$ディスヌフ$$'s Buster Beam.
Later developments revealed that it was one of the units of the $$バスター軍団$$ built for the mission of searching for and recovering $$バスターマシン７号$$.

140.DSCR:
A mothership-class Space Monster that appeared in Episode 2, 'I Don't Want to Become Onee-sama.'
Though its body is far larger than the $$宇宙軍$$'s battleships, it has high mobility.
It was defeated by $$ヴァンセット$$'s one-stroke Buster Sword slash.
140.DSC2:
A mothership-class Space Monster that appeared in Episode 2, 'I Don't Want to Become Onee-sama.'
Though its body is far larger than the $$宇宙軍$$'s battleships, it has high mobility.
It was defeated by $$ヴァンセット$$'s one-stroke Buster Sword slash.
One of the $$バスター軍団$$ that evolved to search for $$バスターマシン７号$$, it has a large cargo space inside.
The reason the $$ビーストロン級$$, which rarely appears at the front, showed itself was to recover the $$ツインテール級$$ that had gathered information on Mars.

141.DSCR:
A small Space Monster that appeared in Episode 3, 'I Hate $$トップレス$$!'
A Space Monster that makes up the swarm circling Jupiter's space, called the '$$木星急行$$.'
It has no armament other than ramming attacks in which it transforms into a knife shape, and its individual combat power is low, but it charges in swarms of astonishing numbers, so there was no effective countermeasure and it was left alone.
Frozen and smashed, swarm and all, by $$キャトフヴァンディス$$'s Buster Smash, it turned to snow and fell onto the artificial planet.
141.DSC2:
A small unit of the $$バスター軍団$$ that appeared in Episode 3, 'I Hate $$トップレス$$!'
A unit of the $$バスター軍団$$ that makes up the swarm circling Jupiter's space, called the '$$木星急行$$,' it has no armament other than ramming attacks in which it transforms into a knife shape, and its individual combat power is low, but it charges in swarms of astonishing numbers, so there was no effective countermeasure and it was left alone.
Frozen and smashed, swarm and all, by $$キャトフヴァンディス$$'s Buster Smash, it turned to snow and fell onto the artificial planet.
The later $$タイタン事件$$ revealed that the purpose of this $$木星急行$$ was surveillance of the real $$宇宙怪獣$$ sleeping on $$タイタン$$, and surveillance and investigation of the children with $$トップレス$$ ability who lived on Jupiter.

142.DSCR:
A $$変動重力源$$ that appeared in Episode 4, 'Revival!! The Legendary $$バスターマシン$$!'
Deep underground on Saturn's moon 'Titan,' together with tens of thousands of Space Monster fossils, it had slept in hibernation for thousands of years while changing the gravity of its surroundings.
It revived and appeared through the hands of the $$サーペンタイン姉妹$$.
It attacks by firing energy bullets that penetrate the moon and can even strike enemies on the far side of the planet, and slender lance-shaped projectiles that easily pierce even the body of a $$バスターマシン$$, and it also performs ramming attacks that make use of its huge body.
142.DSC2:
A $$変動重力源$$ that appeared in Episode 4, 'Revival!! The Legendary $$バスターマシン$$!'
Deep underground on Saturn's moon 'Titan,' together with tens of thousands of Space Monster fossils, it had slept in hibernation for thousands of years while changing the gravity of its surroundings.
It revived and appeared through the hands of the $$サーペンタイン姉妹$$.
Because it slept alongside Space Monster fossils, it was rumored to be an alien $$バスターマシン$$, but its true identity is a cruiser-class (combined type) '$$ギドドンガス級$$' Space Monster.
It attacks by firing energy bullets that penetrate the moon and can even strike enemies on the far side of the planet, and slender lance-shaped projectiles that easily pierce even the body of a $$バスターマシン$$, and it also performs ramming attacks that make use of its huge body.
It killed many of the $$トップレス$$ and turned $$タイタン$$ into hell, but was defeated by the Buster Beam Slash of $$ノノ$$, who had awakened as $$バスターマシン７号$$.
The meat that the $$サーペンタイン姉妹$$ ate as 'Titan crab' was the flesh of this $$変動重力源$$, as part of human experimentation to maintain $$トップレス$$ ability.

143.DSCR:
A super-dreadnought-class $$変動重力源$$ that emerged from the 11th planet, $$ブラックホール・エグゼリオ$$, which exists in the Planet Raoh region.
Even at its appearance it was enormous, with a total length of 18,000 km, but it grew by absorbing the black hole, and in its third evolved form, during the final battle, it reached a size exceeding 30,000 km. With $$トップレス$$ ability, it nullifies nearly every attack.
143.DSC2:
A super-dreadnought-class $$変動重力源$$ that emerged from the 11th planet, $$ブラックホール・エグゼリオ$$, which exists in the Planet Raoh region.
Even at its appearance it was enormous, with a total length of 18,000 km, but it grew by absorbing the black hole, and in its third evolved form, during the final battle, it reached a size exceeding 30,000 km. With $$トップレス$$ ability, it nullifies nearly every attack.
Its true identity is one Space Monster, among those swallowed by the black hole created by the runaway degeneration reactor of $$ヱクセリヲン$$, that absorbed the black hole with its own $$トップレス$$ ability and survived.
It engaged $$ダイバスター$$ and overpowered it, but was defeated by the Inazuma Double Kick of $$バスターマシン７号$$ and $$バスターマシン１９号$$.

148.DSCR:
A vanguard unit of the VF-25 $$メサイア$$ series. Its Battroid mode equipped with the Tornado Pack, atmospheric-use specification.
In $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$, $$アルト$$ pilots this unit.
The VF-25 $$メサイア$$ is the latest multirole variable fighter, a unit jointly developed by the private companies L.A.I. and Shinsei Industry based on the YF-24, a prototype developed by the New United Nations Spacy. It is operated by $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ in the form of evaluation testing prior to official military deployment.
The Tornado Pack is a state-of-the-art reinforcement pack that adds equipment such as a rotary twin beam gun and rotary engine pods to the VF-25. Equipping this pack not only increases firepower, but also greatly improves mobility and maneuverability.
Its main armaments include, in addition to the twin beam gun mounted on its back, a 58mm gatling gun pod, micro-missiles, an assault knife, and more.

150.DSCR:
A vanguard unit of the VF-25 $$メサイア$$ series. Its Battroid mode equipped with the Tornado Pack, exo-atmospheric specification.
In $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$, $$アルト$$ pilots this unit.
The VF-25 $$メサイア$$ is the latest multirole variable fighter. It is a unit jointly developed by the private companies L.A.I. and Shinsei Industry based on the YF-24, a prototype developed by the New United Nations Spacy, and has been deployed to $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ in the form of trial operation.
The Tornado Pack is a state-of-the-art reinforcement pack that adds equipment such as a rotary twin beam gun and rotary engine pods to the VF-25. Equipping this pack not only increases firepower, but also greatly improves mobility and maneuverability.
When a Battroid mode equipped with this pack operates outside the atmosphere, the cooling unit at the rear of the twin beam unit is deployed like a tail. This is because the atmosphere needed to cool the beam generation core and reactor cannot be obtained. Large micro-missile pods are also mounted on the main wing units.
Its main armaments include, in addition to the twin beam gun mounted on its back, a 58mm gatling gun pod, micro-missiles, an assault knife, and more.

164.DSCR:
The $$シャトル$$ Mode of the VB-6 Koenig Monster.
In $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$, $$カナリア$$ pilots this unit.
Making use of its cargo capacity, it is operated with the aim of rapidly deploying overwhelming firepower. In terms of mobility it falls short of the VF series, but it still demonstrates high flight performance even within the atmosphere.
VB stands for 'VARIABLE BOMBER.' In addition to this mode, it can also transform into a Destroid Mode for melee combat and a Gerwalk Mode for use as a mobile gun platform, giving it three transformable forms just like the VF series.
After the Second $$バジュラ$$ Encounter, $$シェリル$$'s nose art came to be painted on it.
